La Cocoteraie Ecolodge | Glamping in Gili Trawangan
top of page
LA COCOTERAIE ECOLODGE
#1 Glamping resort in Gili Trawangan
est. 2013
OUR STORY
Experience luxury in the heart of nature at Gili Trawangan's top glamping resort. Nestled in a coconut plantation on the serene side of the island, our tropical paradise offers guests the best of both worlds. Stay in one of our luxury safari tents and immerse yourself in the beauty of the island while still enjoying all the amenities of a boutique hotel. Once you arrive, you won't want to leave. We're more than just a resort, we're your home away from home.
Make lasting memories on your next holiday with us.
Read more
GLAMPING TENTS
Experience the ultimate luxury camping getaway with glamping. After exploring the beautiful tropical surroundings, retreat to your very own private paradise. Enjoy the convenience of stepping from your terrace straight into your air-conditioned luxury tent. Relax and unwind in ultimate comfort.
Room Facilities
OUR SERVICES
Breakfast
Unique breakfast concept: assemble your own breakfast
Free Wifi
Stay connected with free wifi in our common area and your tent
Welcome drinks
Have a refreshing drink after your long and hot journey
Restaurant & Bar
Open all day for all your needs
Bike rental
We make it that easy for you: explore the island peacefully
Transfers arrangements
Going back to Bali or Lombok? No problem, we can help you
Pool
Take a dip in the water or chill at one of our sunbeds
In-Room Dining Service
Enjoy your food on the terrace outside your tent
Laundry service
Fresh clothes ready the next day for an additional charge
Our rooms
GALLERY
THINGS TO DO
Island hopping snorkeling trip
Book a trip and spot beautiful fish, turtles, and underwater statues
Explore the island by bike
Cycle around the island In less than one hour with our new bikes
Utopia Catamaran
Explore the Gilis on an all-inclusive cruise, more info
Snorkeling
Try to spot some turtles and snorkel from turtle beach
Sunset
Enjoy sunset, and take a photo at one of the many famous Gili T swings
Cooking class
Learn how to make authentic Indonesian dishes, more info
Diving
Go diving and explore some of the world's best coral reefs
Horse Riding
Ride a horse on the beach while the sun is setting
Nightlife
Eat local food at the night market and enjoy live music at various bars
Things to do
WHAT OUR GUESTS SAY
"We loved that was secluded in the middle of the island but close enough to the beach. We loved so much we extended our stay."
Google

Rooms | La Cocoteraie Ecolodge

Explore our
LUXURY TENTS
30 m2
1 Queen bed
2 Guests
1 Bathroom
-LEARN MORE
ABOUT THE LUXURY TENT
Experience luxury glamping at its finest at La Cocoteraie. Our resort features 8 traditional safari tents set in a lush lawned ancient coconut plantation, just steps away from the beach. Each tent is built from local materials and well-maintained to ensure a comfortable and exclusive stay. Enjoy your own slice of paradise and privacy as our tents are positioned close enough to hear the ocean, but spread far enough apart for ultimate seclusion.

Getting There | La Cocoteraie Ecolodge
top of page
YOUR WAY TO LA COCOTERAIE
Whether you need help with transportation, such as arranging a boat ticket or car rental or have any other requests, our friendly staff is here to help. We're pleased to offer pick-up and drop-off service from Bali or Lombok and can assist with any other travel needs. Don't hesitate to reach out to us, it will be our pleasure to help you during your stay in our tropical paradise.

BALI

Bali (All ports)
Transport type

Rp. 625.000 - 720.000 (1p)
We offer a convenient transfer service from your hotel to the harbor and then to the tropical paradise of Gili Trawangan via a fast boat. The approximate journey time is 2,5 hours. The cost of the transfer service depends on various factors such as number of passengers, date and time, and the fast boat company chosen.
Please send us a message with the details and we will provide a pricing plan. Note: We book your fast boat but we are not responsible for the journey.

02. ARRIVE FROM
LOMBOK
From
Lombok Airport
Transport type
Private car & private speed boat
Duration
2 hours
Price
Rp. 1.100.000 - 2.000.000 (1-4p)
We offer a convenient airport transfer service that will take you to Teluk Nare harbor and then to the tropical paradise of Gili Trawangan via speed boat. Our driver will meet you at the airport and take you to the harbor within 1 hour and 45 minutes. The speed boat will take you to Gili Trawangan within 15 minutes.
The cost of the transfer service depends on the number of passengers and if you choose one way or return. This service operates 24 hours a day, with an additional charge for pickup/drop-off between 7:00 pm and 7:00 am.
Lombok
03. ARRIVE FROM
THE HARBOUR
From
Ferry terminal Gili Trawangan
Transport type
Horse cart
Duration
10 minutes
Price
Rp. 100.000 - 150.000 (1-3p)
Experience the tranquility of a car-free island in the peaceful paradise of Gili Trawangan. Motorized vehicles are banned on the island, making for an exceptionally relaxing stay. Once you arrive at the harbor, horse carts are readily available for transportation.
The price depends on the number of passengers and the amount of luggage, with an approximate cost of Rp. 100.000 - 150.000 for 2 persons.

FAQ | La Cocoteraie Ecolodge
top of page
Frequently asked questions
General & policies
Rooms & facilities
Food & drinks
Prices & payment
Location & surroundings
What is your child policy?
Baby (0-3 years) : free baby cot or shared bed with parents
Infant (3-12 years) : additional charge of Rp. 175.000
Maximum of 1 extra infant and/or 1 extra baby per tent.
What are your check in and check out times?
Check in: 12:00 pm - 22:00 pm
Check out: 7:30 am - 10:30 am
What is your cancellation policy?
Standard rate
If cancelled 7 days or more prior to arrival date, no fee will be charged
If cancelled 6 days or less prior to arrival date, 100% of the total price will be charged
In case of no-show , 100% of the total price will be charged.
Non-refundable rate
If this reservation is cancelled, modified or in the event that the guest does not show up, the total reservation rate will be charged. This policy does not allow for a refund under any circumstances (Including a pandemic situation)
How up to date is La Cocoteraie Ecolodge
La Cocoteraie Ecolodge is established in 2013. The latest renovations were done in March 2022 (including brand new tents!).
This website is renewed in January 2023. We try our best to keep everything up to date.
Are bicycles included?
Bicycles are not included anymore in the price per January 2023. To provide you a better service, we have bought new bikes. Due to Covid and without any help from our government, it is not in our capacity to have the new bikes for free.
You can rent our brand new bikes for IDR 50.000 per day per bike.
DIDN'T FIND YOUR ANSWER?
Send us a message below for all your glamping resort questions. We are happy to help you!
